info.name: TableCheck API - V1 availability reservations API

params.name: ids
params.description: Array or comma-separated list of specific reservation IDs to return.

params.name: shop_ids
params.description: Array or comma-separated list of shop IDs to filter reservations.

params.name: created_at_min
params.description: Search lower bound of created_at field (ISO timestamp).

params.description: Search upper bound of created_at field (ISO timestamp).

params.description: Search upper bound of start_at field (ISO timestamp).

params.name: page
params.description: The zero-based page number. Used for pagination.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Number of items to return at once. Used for pagination.

params.description: The field by which to sort the results.

params.name: sort_order
params.description: The direction to sort the results (asc or desc.)
